name: List Replicability Number of the Three-Code Class
proof: The three-code class has spherical dimension one.  The spherical-dimension list-replicability theorem therefore gives $\mathrm{LR}\geq\lceil(1+3)/2\rceil=2$.  Its sign rank is two, and the established sign-rank upper bound gives $\mathrm{LR}\leq2$.  Hence $\mathrm{LR}=2$.
